"""Framing, void results, composed bindings, arg bounds, reuse."""
import base64, json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

CLI = [sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py']

def run_raw(data):
    r = subprocess.run(CLI, input=data, capture_output=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

def run_campaign(campaign):
    return run_raw(json.dumps(campaign).encode())

# --- framing ---
for bad in [b'', b'   ', b'[1,2]', b'5', b'"x"', b'null', b'{"a":1}{"b":2}',
            b'{"a":1} x', b'{"a":NaN}', b'{"a":Infinity}', b'{"a":-Infinity}',
            b'{"a":1e400}', b'{"a":1,"a":2}', b'\xff\xfe', b'{"a":\xff}',
            b'{unclosed', b'{"a":01}']:
    out = run_raw(bad)
    assert out == {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"}, (bad, out)
# valid framing oddities -> still processes
assert run_raw(b'{}') == {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []}
assert run_raw(b' {"types":[]} ') == {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []}
assert run_raw(b'{"a":1e308}') == {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []}

# --- void result ---
types = [
    {"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "V", "kind": "void"},
    {"name": "Ch", "kind": "char"},
]
mod = {"name": "m", "params": [["n", "N8"], ["c", "Ch"]], "result": ["v", "V"], "requires": None}
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [mod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
            "runs": [{"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", le(1, 1)), ("x1", le(255, 1))]))}]}
out = run_campaign(campaign)
assert out['plans'][0]['slots'] == [["x0", ["n"], 1], ["x1", ["c"], 1]]
assert out['plans'][0]['variables'] == 2
assert out['records'] == [{'status': 'READY', 'case': 0, 'model_result': None}], out
assert out['corpus'][0]['inputs'] == {"n": 1, "c": "\u00ff"}

# --- deep filter chain with composed bindings + reuse with different bindings ---
# entry e: params a: N8, b: N8; result r: B; requires null
#   pipe(e, f1, {p: a}); pipe(e, f1, {p: b})        -> reuse, two applications
#   pipe(f1, f2, {q: p}); pipe(f2, f3, {z: q})      -> composed: z->p->(a or b)
# f1: p != 0; f2: q < 200; f3: z != 9
e = {"name": "e", "params": [["a", "N8"], ["b", "N8"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}
f1 = {"name": "f1", "params": [["p", "N8"]], "result": ["r1", "B"],
      "requires": ["ne", ["var", "p"], ["const", "N8", 0]]}
f2 = {"name": "f2", "params": [["q", "N8"]], "result": ["r2", "B"],
      "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "N8", 200]]}
f3 = {"name": "f3", "params": [["z", "N8"]], "result": ["r3", "B"],
      "requires": ["ne", ["var", "z"], ["const", "N8", 9]]}
pipes = [
    {"target": "e", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"p": "a"}},
    {"target": "e", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"p": "b"}},
    {"target": "f1", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"q": "p"}},
    {"target": "f2", "filter": "f3", "bind": {"z": "q"}},
]
# layout: a x0, b x1, r x2, flag x3 -> variables 4
def mk(a, b, res, flagv):
    return {"entry": "e", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", le(a, 1)), ("x1", le(b, 1)),
                                              ("x2", le(res, 1)), ("x3", le(flagv, 1))]))}
runs = [
    mk(5, 6, 0, 0),   # all accept -> READY
    mk(9, 6, 0, 1),   # z=9 via a: f3 rejects -> not accept; flag 1 -> FILTERED
    mk(9, 6, 0, 0),   # same but flag 0 -> INVALID (attestation)
    mk(5, 0, 0, 1),   # p=0 via b: f1 rejects -> FILTERED
    mk(250, 6, 0, 1), # q=250: f2 rejects -> FILTERED
    mk(5, 6, 1, 0),   # dup
]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [e, f1, f2, f3], "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["e"], "machine": None, "runs": runs}
out = run_campaign(campaign)
statuses = [r['status'] for r in out['records']]
assert statuses == ['READY', 'FILTERED', 'INVALID_TEST', 'FILTERED', 'FILTERED', 'DUPLICATE'], statuses
assert out['plans'][0]['modules'] == ['f3', 'f2', 'f1', 'e'], out['plans'][0]['modules']
assert out['plans'][0]['flag'] == 'x3'
assert out['corpus'][0]['witnesses'] == [0, 5]

# --- KTEST argument bounds ---
def argkt(args, objs):
    return ktest(objs, args=args)
base_objs = [("x0", le(1, 1)), ("x1", le(1, 1)), ("x2", le(1, 1)), ("x3", le(0, 1))]
cases = [
    (argkt([b'prog', b'-x'] * 2, base_objs), 'OK'),           # 4 args fine
    (argkt([b'a'] * 65, base_objs), 'INVALID_TEST'),           # 65 args
    (argkt([b'a'] * 64, base_objs), 'OK'),                     # 64 args ok
    (argkt([b'x' * 257], base_objs), 'INVALID_TEST'),          # arg too long
    (argkt([b'x' * 256], base_objs), 'OK'),                    # 256 ok
    (ktest(base_objs, sym_argc=999, sym_len=12345), 'OK'),     # bookkeeping ignored
]
for data, want in cases:
    out = run_campaign({"types": types, "modules": [e, f1, f2, f3], "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
                        "entries": ["e"], "machine": None,
                        "runs": [{"entry": "e", "ktest": b64(data)}]})
    got = out['records'][0]['status']
    assert (got == 'READY') == (want == 'OK'), (want, got, out)

# --- empty base64 -> binary error ---
out = run_campaign({"types": types, "modules": [e], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                    "entries": ["e"], "machine": None, "runs": [{"entry": "e", "ktest": ""}]})
assert out['records'] == [{'status': 'INVALID_TEST'}]
print("T7 OK")
